static_traits.name: Chen Danni
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with classmates and teachers growing tense due to Anxiety and Self-doubt; has several supportive friends but has not yet shared troubles with them.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not previously received psychotherapy; no similar problems occurred in the past.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe emotions and thoughts specifically; fairly cooperative; narrative tends toward negativity, catastrophizing and negating positive evidence; often engages in self-comparison and Self-doubt.

basic_info.main_problem: I have always feared I will never graduate; this Fear causes obvious distress and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the Fear and Anxiety about being unable to graduate have begun affecting my academic performance and overall well-being.

core_beliefs: I am not as good as others,I am not competent enough
If goals cannot be perfectly achieved, it equals complete failure

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If this exam performance is not good enough, it means I am not capable and will never graduate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to stay 'positive', working overtime on learning, but developing dropout thoughts under Increased stress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might fail courses; I will never graduate

special_situations.event: Starting new assignments or facing academic tasks feels like 'an unclimbable mountain'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot immediately understand and do well, it proves I am not smart enough and have no ability to complete my studies
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated Self-denial, difficulty starting tasks, slowed progress leading to assignment procrastination and falling behind
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This assignment is too hard; I definitely cannot do it well

special_situations.event: Sees other classmates who seem to 'all handle it very well'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are better than me, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compares with others, avoids communicating with others to avoid being compared or evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, I am just a failure

special_situations.event: Thinking about the future and current Work prospects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot graduate smoothly, I will be stuck in this job forever and others will all look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing with friends to avoid 'troubling others' or being judged, repeatedly rehearsing worst-case scenarios in mind
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will stay trapped in my current Work; everyone will think I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to prove self-worth through academic achievement and gain others' recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fearing shame and being negated after failure, being seen by others as not good enough
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by avoiding disclosure and self-deprecating
Gaining a false sense of control by catastrophically rehearsing worst outcomes, relieving uncertainty Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent Student who could fail at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are judgmental, have high expectations, and are more capable (classmates/teachers/the public)

object_relations.self_representation: A person who might burden others
object_relations.object_representation: Others/friends burdened by me or displeased by my confiding

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes one's successes or positive evidence (such as passing midterms, receiving good reviews)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these successes 'do not count', or feeling the counselor is merely comforting and cannot understand one's situation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slightly negating tone, repeating 'this is not enough' and 'just luck', using exception interpretation to undermine the meaning of achievements.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share with friends or others and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that confiding in others will trouble them or lead to being looked down on (presumes negative reactions from others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding committing to seek help, using the phrasing 'I do not want to trouble others', hesitant tone, minimizing one's own needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing future academic and career uncertainties
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Constructing worst-case scenarios in mind to avoid facing reality's complexity and uncertainty
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use extreme words (e.g., 'forever', 'a lifetime'), rapidly sketching the worst script, slightly fast speech, emotional.

manifestations: Full of uncertainty and Anxiety about future academic completion and career-choice outcomes
Strong Self-doubt and catastrophic imagining when taking on learning and graduation responsibilities
outcomes: Difficulty concentrating and declining academic performance

manifestations: Has supportive friends but unwilling to share troubles, worrying about 'troubling others'
Relationships with classmates and teachers growing tense due to Anxiety and Self-denial
outcomes: Limited access to emotional support, intensified sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not as good as them')
Worries about disturbing others and avoids seeking help or sharing feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turns the impulse to seek support into bearing it oneself, ruminating on worries at night
At high-pressure academic junctures, chooses to carry it alone rather than seek outside support

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming 'everyone will think I am a failure' and reducing contact with others
Because of worrying about being judged, becomes distant from classmates and teachers

exception_events.target_problem: When approaching exams or starting academic tasks, the client is usually trapped by the Fear 'I will never graduate', showing scattered attention, decreased efficiency and withdrawal thoughts.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Passed the midterm exam smoothly, performing better than worried.
exception_events.reason: Cue: attendance and basic review input were maintained, and the actual ability was brought into play; the positive feedback from that examination weakened the catastrophic prediction.

exception_events.target_problem: When facing coursework, the client often slows down and falls behind due to Self-doubt, and keeps worrying about being negated.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Some course projects received positive feedback and praise from teachers, with results better than his self-anticipation.
exception_events.reason: Clues: completed key parts of tasks and submitted on time; different support: positive feedback from teachers temporarily interrupted the negative narrative.

positive_force: Has the practical ability to complete tasks (passed the midterm exam, received project praise before)
Has several supportive friends, with potential social support resources
Able to actively seek help (choosing to come for counseling)
Still tries to persist in study and focus on academics under pressure
negative_force: Catastrophizing, mind-reading and negating-positive-evidence thinking reinforces failure anticipation
Insufficient confidence, excessive comparison with others
Avoiding seeking help, worrying about troubling others, leading to Limited access to support
Disturbed sleep and appetite further weaken learning and emotion-regulation ability

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated catastrophic self-talk ('I will never graduate')
antecedent: Starting new assignments or study tasks
Thinking about future academic and career prospects
target_behavior.core_reason: Insufficient confidence and comparison with others, accompanied by predictive thinking about future failure and the cognitive bias of negating positive evidence.
target_behavior.function: Gaining brief 'mental preparation/sense of control' by presetting worst outcomes, to reduce uncertainty Anxiety (short-term negative reinforcement).
target_behavior.consequence: Rising Anxiety, decreased attention, slowed assignment progress with dropout thoughts, further affecting academic performance and Interpersonal relationships.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding seeking help and not discussing troubles with friends/others
antecedent: Presumes others will be 'troubled' by him or look down on him
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged and shame, projecting inner negative expectations onto others.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluation and shame experiences.
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, increased sense of isolation, Anxiety maintained or even worsened.

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep difficulties and appetite disturbance (difficulty falling asleep, tossing and turning at night; appetite fluctuations)
antecedent: Ruminating on academic worries before bed
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent catastrophic worrying and negative anticipation raise physiological arousal.
target_behavior.function: Rumination creates the short-term illusion of 'thinking about coping/being prepared', delaying facing the present feelings of Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient sleep and worsening physical state lead to decreased cognitive efficiency, scattered attention, declining academic performance.
